---
title: element-text
subtitle: "Text element: font size, weight, colour, and angle."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Pass the result to [`theme`](theme.qmd) under keys like `axis-text`, `axis-title`,
`legend-text`, or `legend-title`.

## Usage

```typst
element-text(
  size: none,
  weight: none,
  colour: none,
  angle: none,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `none` | Text size (a Typst length), or `none` to inherit. |
| `weight` | `none` | Font weight (e.g. `"regular"`, `"bold"`), or `none`. |
| `colour` | `none` | Text colour, or `none` to inherit. |
| `angle` | `none` | Rotation angle (a Typst angle), or `none`. |

## Returns

Element dictionary consumed by [`theme`](theme.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/element-text-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme(axis-title: element-text(size: 14pt)),
)
```
